channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Myles Turner | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Myles Turner from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Breanna Stewart on Myles Turner
item.description:
“You don’t see the podcasts with the breakdowns right after [games], so I want to do that with Myles [Turner].”

Breanna Stewart on Myles Turner, Jan 23, 2026. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Myles Turner
item.description:
#Bucks’ Giannis Antetokounmpo on Myles Turner being booed in Indy:

“It is bigger than sport. …He’s gonna go back home and he’s gonna be like, ‘OK, 10 years just went down the drain.’ And that’s not fair for anybody that gave 10 years to the game and 10 years to the #Pacers.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Myles Turner, Nov 4, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Myles Turner
item.description:
Giannis Antetokounmpo, on the Bucks adding Myles Turner:

“He's one of the bigs that we can fit so well together. He's one of the best bigs in the league.... So, I'm very excited for him. I think that was an incredible move.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Myles Turner, Sep 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner
item.description:
Alex Golden:Tyrese Haliburton on recording 3 blocks in a game for the 3rd time this season:

“I appreciate that Alex, thank you for recognizing that…so it goes: Myles Turner, Rik Smits, Jermaine O’Neal, Roy Hibbert, Tyrese Haliburton. That’s how it’s gonna end when I’m done here…but in my mindset, I’m the 5th best shot blocker in franchise history and you can’t tell me different.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner, Apr 11, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Chad Buchanan on Myles Turner
item.description:
“I'm reading the Myles Turner trade rumors out there at the trade deadline, and I'm just [asking], 'Where in the world do people get this information?'Sometimes we as a front office sit back and laugh because it's unreal where some of this information comes from.”

Chad Buchanan on Myles Turner, Feb 24, 2025. Source: athlonsports.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Turner wasn’t familiar with his music but told Carlisle he would definitely check him out.

“I greatly admire Myles Turner as a guy who has wide-ranging and eclectic taste in music,”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Nov 12, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Myles Turner
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on the Myles Turner push:

“Myles is a good kid. Let's start with that. Throughout the series, he loses control of his body a little bit... I was just letting him know, 'Just watch it.'.. He feels like he's at home, his family is watching. Hisgirl is probably watching and he had to do something. I've known Myles a long time... It's all love.”

Jaylen Brown on Myles Turner, May 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Myles Turner
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Donte DiVincenzo on dustup with Myles Turner:

“They’re trying to be tough guys. And that’s not their identity. …Nobody is going to fight in the NBA.Take the foul and keep it moving. You’re not a tough guy.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Myles Turner, May 14, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on the Myles Turner illegal screen call:

“I don’t want to talk about the officiating. We’re not expecting to get calls in here. It would be nice if they laid off that one, but they didn’t. That’s just the way it goes. We challenged it. They reviewed it. They’ve got a bunch of people in New Jersey that agreed with them, so that’s just the way it goes.”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, May 6, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Obi Toppin on Myles Turner, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Obi Toppin:

“It’s easy to play with Tyrese. He’s so willing to give up the ball. But he’s such a threat offensively with his scoring that he draws so much attention. That allows other people to get open. They found a way to play with each other. It’s been great. It’s just like Tyrese and Myles Turner. With both of them, I think they’re the best duo in pick-and-roll in the league. I think so. Don’t quote me on that.”

Obi Toppin on Myles Turner, Tyrese Haliburton, Mar 28, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Myles Turner
item.description:
Charles Barkley:

“I bet it's probably fun for [Myles Turner] being at home for the All-Star Game… Being able to sleep in your own bed, that’s the best thing for him this weekend.”

Charles Barkley on Myles Turner, Feb 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Carlisle attended Turner's camp last summer and was eager to show support again, given how hands-on Turner is with the camp experience despite there being two age groups each lasting for four hours for two full days.

“The thing I think is really special about this is that Myles Turner is completely involved with everything,”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Aug 3, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Carlisle said jokingly,

“He’s not been traded, as I guess Twitter is saying. Believe me, I have no interest in trading Myles Turner.”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Jan 12, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Malcolm Brogdon on Myles Turner, Robert Williams
item.description:
Malcolm Brogdon on Robert Williams:

“I played with a great shot blocker in Myles Turner in Indiana. So to play with another one, I think those are the two best shot blockers in the league. So to play with him this year is going to be amazing.”

Malcolm Brogdon on Myles Turner, Robert Williams, Dec 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
Pritchard on Turner and Sabonis:

“I think the guys wanted to work, but it just was a little clunky at times … I thought, if there’s an opportunity to maybe let one stand up and leave and one to get to another place and have his opportunity, that we would look at it.”

Kevin Pritchard on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Feb 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
James Boyd:Rick Carlisle:

“Myles (Turner) had another scan. The news is good. Doctors are seeing what that want to see. … The hope is that he can return at some point sooner than later.”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Jan 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
Scott Agness:Carlisle on Sabonis-Turner pairing:

“I do believe these guys can play effectively together, but I also believe there may be a formula that may be different than today’s formula of 5-out.”

Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Myles Turner
item.description:
The organization has spoken with the Indiana Pacers about a deal, with Myles Turner's name being in those conversations, The Ringer's Kevin O'Connor reported Friday morning.

“They are having trade conversations, I have not seen reported that, I believe I had it in my story that they've had some conversations with the Pacers,the Pacers have been one of the more active teams, the name that I've heard involved in those conversations is Myles Turner,”

Kevin O'Connor on Myles Turner, Jul 24, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Carlisle on Sabonis/Turner combo:

“I think there's ways we can stagger them in the lineup with the rotation so they can play together some but 1 play w/o the other.”

Rick Carlisle on Domantas Sabonis, Myles Turner, Jun 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Myles Turner
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on Turner playing vs Magic on Friday:

“He keeps telling me he isn't waiting. He wants to be out there.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Myles Turner, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Scott Agness:Rick Carlisle on local product Myles Turner:

“He’s one of the great young players in our league. … He’s a high-impact player at both ends.”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Feb 27, 2019. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner
item.description:
Carlisle on Bedford's Myles Turner:

“I love him. He’s the future of the 5 position in the NBA. A guy that roll and finish above the rim, can half-roll and make the plays. He can shoot mid-range and he can shoot long range and he can drive the ball. He’s got the whole skill set.”

Rick Carlisle on Myles Turner, Jan 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: TJ Leaf on Myles Turner
item.description:
Nate Taylor:TJ Leaf on playing with Myles Turner:

“It gives us the ability to put 5 guys out on the floor that can stretch it & shoot the 3.”

TJ Leaf on Myles Turner, Jun 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Myles Turner
item.description:
Nate Taylor:Nate McMillan:

“The biggest thing we want to address with Myles Turner is strength. Part of that is maturity.”

Nate McMillan on Myles Turner, Apr 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByNateTaylor.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Myles Turner
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Frank Vogel on starting 19-year-old Myles Turner:

“It’s glaring to me that we need to increase his role, his minutes, his everything.”

Frank Vogel on Myles Turner, Jan 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
